1.label: very_easy
1.summary: Watch one slower three-shell shuffle. A wide peephole stays available through the stop, so the direct task is to identify the visible shuttle and select its carrier.
1.natural_language: Track the marked token through one shuffle. When the paired shells enter the cover, inspect its wide peephole and select the carrier at the stop.

2.label: easy
2.summary: Preserves the original three independent four-or-five-shell shuffles exactly: one or two visible token transfers, seven-tick peephole windows, and three samples per round; the record remains available at the stop.
2.natural_language: Track the marked token. When paired shells enter a cover, hold the cursor over its peephole and read the physical shuttle.

3.label: medium
3.summary: The same three-round carrier task adds a pulsing decoy peephole and a shorter five-tick genuine inspection whose record remains available at the stop. The operator must identify the cover containing the paired shells instead of merely moving to the only illuminated port.
3.natural_language: Track each marked carrier. When peepholes pulse, inspect the cover containing the paired shells, read the shuttle, and select the final carrier after every stop.

4.label: hard
4.summary: Four rounds run through five or six shells with two pulsing decoy ports, a five-tick genuine port, and tighter cursor placement. The relevant cover must be distinguished while the shell field keeps moving, with its record retained at the stop.
4.natural_language: Follow every marked carrier through the shell field. At each pulse, inspect the physical cover holding the paired shells, then certify all four recorded carriers.

5.label: very_hard
5.summary: Four faster six-shell rounds contain three visually identical decoy peepholes. The genuine five-tick inspection requires locating the paired cover, keeping the cursor inside its narrow port, and selecting the final carrier at each stop before certification; the record remains available after the stop.
5.natural_language: Audit four fast shell shuffles. Ignore decoy peepholes, inspect every paired cover and certify the four final carriers.

simplified.summary: Use the visible peephole-relay button to align the inspection lens and use labelled carrier controls after each stop. The same port, timing, carrier history, samples, and selections are graded.

full.summary: Move the pointer directly onto the physical peephole during its window and click the stopped shell carrying the recorded carrier label.
